0022600087.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Brooklyn Nets host the Charlotte Hornets. The Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 117-86 home loss on March 31, their most recent meeting. Joshua Jefferson is out for Brooklyn with a back issue, while Charlotte's Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell are all day-to-day with game-time decisions, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Nets a 40% chance to win.
